notes.title: Easter event, Remote Play Together and more!
notes.content:
Hello rescuers,

It's time to celebrate spring and we have some exciting news: a new patch is now available for download, which includes new features, adjustments and a special Easter event!

From March 24th to April 30th you will find special eggs hidden in the stages of Rescue Party: Live!. By collecting them, you will have the opportunity to obtain special in-game items, such as cute skins for your favorite character!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40923917/8e80aefb8100333b94f7f9dc2e122629104b360b.png

Here the complete changelog:


Remote Play Together function added, in order to make it easier for players to team up with their friends.
Players can now play the tutorial level with their friends under the story mode. This can help your new friends to play and learn at the same time!
Added a set of Easter skins (obtainable by collecting eggs in the levels Residential District, Pinestone Canyon, Sunken Ferry, Chemical Plant, Highway Bridge and Snow Mountain Park).
Added a set of Easter tiaras (obtainable through the tournament mode rewards).
Added some Easter decorations to the main menu.
Changed loading screen tips to be more clear. 
Added tips for throwing stuff around.
Added highlighting to key rescue supplies to prevent players from missing key items.
Added star rating display for passed levels on the big map.
Removing props from the backpack now requires holding the button, reducing the possibility of player misuse.
Visual effects adjustment.

We are constantly working to optimize the in-game experience and we hope you will enjoy this update!

Thanks for your feedback and your support.

Remember to stop by our Twitter or Discord channel to let us know what you think of the game and share with us your experience.

notes.title: New update available now!
notes.content:
Hi Rescuers,

A new patch for Rescue Party: Live! is now available for download.

Here’s the changelog:


UI adapts to different screen sizes and ratios
Added the keyboard custom key function
Modified the length of game tournament and the number of levels, the original game tournament is 6 levels, now the tournament is 4 levels
Fixed the problem that some controllers were incompatible or unusable
Casual mode optimized difficulty, suitable for more novice players
You can now use the mouse to navigate the game menu
Support controllers being plugged in on the fly
Optimization of search buddy response speed
Added four graphic quality options: low, medium, high, and extra high. Users can freely choose the image quality according to their computer configuration
Thanks for your feedback and your support!

Remember to stop by our Twitter, Facebook group, or Discord channel to let us know what you think of the game and share with us your experience.

notes.title: 1.14 Hot fix clarifications
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40923917/2b3615484a8a521a6b8ce424c8c8d9506d5478d8.png

Hi Rescuers,

After your reports, the team worked on the first patch for Rescue Party: Live! and now it is available for download.

Here’s the changelog:


 Fixed a bug related to Steam VR launching at the start of the game.
 Improved how the game identifies and re-configure input automatically during single player mode, this solves the controller issues some players are experiencing.
 Added a message to highlight if in multiplayer all the players use the same cross-play settings.
Thanks for your feedback and your support!

Remember to stop by our Twitter, Facebook group, or Discord channel to let us know what you think of the game and share with us your experience.

notes.title: First DEMO is live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40923917/db421c1eeb7a19c8bf38a6e3d10fcbd41d34b3ae.png

Rescuers, it's time to show your skills and become heroes! 

The first free DEMO of Rescue Party: Live! is now available to play during the Steam Next Fest.

From today to the 7th of October become a professional rescuer with your friends and show your skills by saving your fellow citizens!

In this demo you will be able to enjoy:


 A Story Mode to play in solo or with your friends
 A Championship Mode to challenge other rescuers online
 3 Levels (fully playable)
 Different skins to customize your hero

We can't wait to see you in action! 

Share your funniest moments and feedback with us on Twitter, join our Discord channel or our brand new Facebook group.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1662570/Rescue_Party_Live/

Stay Safe!
